description: Add a comment to a weclapp record — the internal note on an order, customer, shipment etc. Required: entity_name (salesOrder, party, shipment, quotation, salesInvoice, task, ...), entity_id and text. Visible to all weclapp users of the instance; private: true makes it visible to the author only. It is not sent to the customer. WRITES into the customer's ERP — it goes through the permission gate and the weclapp write log.

entity_name.description: weclapp entity type, e.g. salesOrder, party, shipment, quotation, salesInvoice, task

private.description: true = visible to the author only

text.description: Comment text (internal, not sent to the customer)

name: create_weclapp_comment
